Hahahaha!\nI like you. What's your name?
My name...?\nWhat's that? I don't know...
What? You don't know your own name?\nSo what do people call you?
Fine, I'll give you a name if you don't have one!\nLet's see, since you look like Venena,\nwhat about...Nena? Yeah, let's go with Nena!
Hahaha! You fell!! Right into the hole!!
Hey, Nena!\nMaking something like this won't make you a good\ngirl, you know?!
Huh? Er...um...right!\nBeing helpful to others, that's what a good girl\ndoes.
Nena!\nYou damn monster! I'll kill you!!
Hang in there! You can't die!
It's my fault...This happened because I brought\nCoenubia into this village...All these good\npeople...they died because of me!!
Don't blame yourself...It's our fate...We were\ndestined to be eliminated...It was only a matter\nof time...We can't fight fate...
Tell me...am I a good girl?
